crossRefs.note: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father…
Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword…
They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.
translations.bsb: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
translations.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
translations.asv: So he cometh to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph:
